features:
BARRAGE - Smash the City
Update Log & Feature List (2026-10-06)
FEATURE EXCLUSIVES & BYPASSES
- No Cooldown [BYPASS]: Weapons become ready again immediately after firing.
- Power Past Cap [BYPASS]: Pushes weapon power beyond the normal slider maximum with Mega 2x, Extreme 3x, or Insane 5x.
- Use Any Weapon [BYPASS]: Temporarily uses unbought weapons, cities, and Pass/Robux weapons without permanently unlocking or saving them.
- Infinite Coins [BYPASS]: Adds coins every second with 1K, 10K, or 100K presets.
AUTO SMASH
- Auto Smash: Automatically fires at the city using Equipped, Strongest Ready, or Selected Only weapons with Densest Block or Random Building targeting.
- Smash Presets: Steady, Fast, or Blatant with Game Max sliders, drag time, and configurable shot delay.
- Auto City: Loads the next owned city or restarts your current city at a chosen destruction percentage, defaulting to 80%. Host only.
AUTO BUY
- Auto Buy Weapons: Buys using Cheapest First, Strongest Affordable, or Selected Only while maintaining a coin reserve and skipping Group/Robux weapons.
- Auto Buy Cities: Buys cities using Cheapest First or Most Expensive with a configurable coin reserve.
REWARDS
- Auto Claim: Claims Daily Reward, Daily Challenges, and Group Weapons either When Done or Instantly.
- Auto Codes: Redeems selected codes and automatically selects newly added codes.
ROOMS
- Auto Join Requests: Automatically accepts or declines incoming join requests.
- City Lock: Keeps your hosted city locked.
MODS
- Weapon Mods: No Cooldown and Power Past Cap.
- Unlock Mods: Use Any Weapon and Infinite Coins.
PERFORMANCE
- Auto Clear Debris: Removes debris automatically once it passes a chosen limit.
- Display Options: Low Debris Cap, No Screen Shake, and Mute Sound.
